get.description:
Return the API version, the scopes of the token that authenticated the request,
and the authenticated user. Use it to check which scopes a token has.

Authentication is optional. `auth` is null unless the request uses a token or API
key. `user` is null for anonymous requests and for credentials that don't belong
to a user, such as API keys and organization auth tokens.

scopes.description: Scopes stored on the token or API key that authenticated the request

auth.description: The credentials that authenticated the request, or null for session and anonymous requests

name.description: User's identifier at the auth provider

organization.description: Organization the auth provider belongs to

id.description: Auth provider key, such as google or saml2

name.description: Display name of the auth provider

dateVerified.description: When the identity was last verified by signing in through the auth provider

dateSynced.description: When the identity was last synced from the auth provider

identities.description: SSO identities of the user. Only included for the requesting user, unless the request has active superuser or staff access

avatarUuid.description: ID of the uploaded avatar image, or null

avatarUrl.description: URL of the avatar image, or null if none is set

type.description: Authenticator type, such as totp, sms, u2f or recovery

name.description: Display name of the authenticator type

dateUsed.description: When the authenticator was last used, or null

authenticators.description: Two-factor authenticators of the user, without backup methods such as recovery codes

canReset2fa.description: Whether the organization can reset the user's two-factor authentication. True only if the user is a member of exactly one active organization

name.description: Display name: the user's name, or their email or username if no name is set

avatarUrl.description: Gravatar URL for the primary email address

isSuspended.description: Whether the account is suspended. Suspended users can't sign in

hasPasswordAuth.description: Whether the user has a password set

isManaged.description: Whether the account is managed, which stops the user from changing their username, password and similar details

lastLogin.description: When the user last signed in, or null

has2fa.description: Whether the user has two-factor authentication enabled

lastActive.description: When the user was last active, or null

isSuperuser.description: Whether the user is a superuser

isStaff.description: Whether the user has staff status

is_verified.description: Whether the email address is verified

emails.description: Email addresses of the user. Only included for the requesting user or superusers; empty otherwise

stacktraceOrder.description: Stack trace frame order: -1 for the default (most recent first), 1 for most recent last, 2 for most recent first

defaultIssueEvent.description: Event shown by default on issue details: "recommended", "latest" or "oldest"

timezone.description: Time zone for displayed dates, such as `UTC`

clock24Hours.description: Whether times are shown in 24-hour format

prefersIssueDetailsStreamlinedUI.description: Whether the user prefers the streamlined issue details UI, or null if they haven't chosen

newsletter_consent_prompt.description: Whether to ask the user for newsletter consent

user.description: The authenticated user, or null for anonymous requests and requests made with an API key or organization auth token

get.description:
Return a list of organizations available to the authenticated session in a region.
This is particularly useful for requests with a user bound context. For API key-based requests this will only return the organization that belongs to the key.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Specify `true` to restrict results to organizations in which you are an owner.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/).

Valid query fields include:
- `id`: The organization ID
- `slug`: The organization slug
- `status`: The organization's current status (one of `active`, `pending_deletion`, or `deletion_in_progress`)
- `email` or `member_id`: Filter your organizations by the emails or [organization member IDs](/api/organizations/list-an-organizations-members/) of specific members included
- `query`: Filter your organizations by name, slug, and members that contain this substring

Example: `query=(slug:foo AND status:active) OR (email:[thing-one@example.com,thing-two@example.com] AND query:bar)`

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort results by, in descending order. If not specified the results are sorted by the date they were created.

Valid fields include:
- `members`: By number of members
- `events`: By number of events in the past 24 hours

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.

extraOptions.description: Server-wide options that the Sentry UI reads

access.description: Scopes the requesting user has in the organization

task.description: Onboarding task key, such as create_project

completionSeen.description: When the task's completion was marked as seen, or null

dateCompleted.description: When the task was completed or skipped

invited_member_id.description: ID of the member whose invite completed the invite_member task

platform.description: Platform of the first event, for the first_event task

plugin.description: Slug of the plugin enabled for the task

providers.description: Integration providers installed for the integrations task

data.description: Data recorded for the task. Most tasks record none, so it's often empty

onboardingTasks.description: Onboarding tasks the organization has completed or skipped

id.description: Status ID: active, pending_deletion, deletion_in_progress or relocation_pending_approval

name.description: Status label, such as active or pending deletion
Organization name, or its slug when it has no name

isEarlyAdopter.description: Whether the organization is an early adopter

require2FA.description: Whether members must use two-factor authentication

avatarUuid.description: ID of the uploaded avatar image, or null

avatarUrl.description: URL of the avatar image, or null if none is set

regionUrl.description: Base URL of the API for the organization's region

hasAuthProvider.description: Whether SSO is configured for the organization

allowMemberInvite.description: Whether members can invite other members

allowSuperuserAccess.description: Whether Sentry superusers can access the organization

get.description:
**Deprecated**: This endpoint has been replaced with the [Organization Issues endpoint](/api/events/list-an-organizations-issues/) which
supports filtering on project and additional functionality.

Return a list of issues (groups) bound to a project.  All parameters are supplied as query string parameters. 

 A default query of ``is:unresolved`` is applied. To return results with other statuses send an new query value (i.e. ``?query=`` for all results).

The ``statsPeriod`` parameter can be used to select the timeline stats which should be present. Possible values are: ``""`` (disable),``"24h"`` (default), ``"14d"``

User feedback items from the [User Feedback Widget](https://docs.sentry.io/product/user-feedback/#user-feedback-widget) are built off the issue platform, so to return a list of user feedback items for a specific project, filter for `issue.category:feedback`.

parameters.name: organization_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the organization the issues belong to.

parameters.name: project_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the project the issues belong to.

parameters.name: statsPeriod
parameters.description: An optional stat period (can be one of `"24h"`, `"14d"`, and `""`), defaults to "24h" if not provided.

parameters.name: shortIdLookup
parameters.description: If this is set to `1` then short IDs are looked up by this function as well. This can cause the return value of the function to return an event issue of a different project which is why this is an opt-in.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: An optional Sentry structured search query. If not provided an implied `"is:unresolved"` is assumed.

parameters.name: hashes
parameters.description: A list of hashes of groups to return. Is not compatible with 'query' parameter. The maximum number of hashes that can be sent is 100. If more are sent, only the first 100 will be used.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order of the issues. Options include 'Last Seen' (`date`), 'First Seen' (`new`), 'Trends' (`trends`), 'Events' (`freq`), 'Users' (`user`), and 'Recommended' (`recommended`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of issues to return. The maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

annotations.description: Annotations on the issue, such as links to external issues.

assignedTo.description: The user or team the issue is assigned to. Null when the issue is unassigned.

type.description: Whether the assignee is a user or a team.

id.description: The ID of the user or team.

name.description: The display name of the user, or the slug of the team.

count.description: The total number of events in the issue.

culprit.description: The function or module where the issue occurs.

firstSeen.description: When the issue was first seen (ISO 8601).

hasSeen.description: Whether the requesting user has seen the issue since it last occurred.

isBookmarked.description: Whether the requesting user bookmarked the issue.

isPublic.description: Whether the issue is shared publicly.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the requesting user is subscribed to the issue.

lastSeen.description: When the issue was last seen (ISO 8601).

level.description: The severity level of the issue, such as `error` or `warning`.

logger.description: The logger of the issue's events.

metadata.description: Metadata of the issue. Its keys depend on the issue type.

filename.description: The file where the error was raised.

numComments.description: The number of comments on the issue.

permalink.description: The URL of the issue in Sentry.

project.description: The project the issue belongs to.

shareId.description: The ID used in the issue's public share URL. Null when the issue isn't shared.

shortId.description: The short ID of the issue, such as `PROJECT-1A`.

stats.description: Event counts for the issue over time.

24h.description: Hourly event counts for the last 24 hours, as [timestamp, count] pairs.

statusDetails.description: Details of the issue's status, such as when an ignore expires or which release resolves it. Empty when the status has no details.

ignoreCount.description: Number of additional events after which the issue stops being ignored.

ignoreUntil.description: When the issue stops being ignored.

ignoreUserCount.description: Number of additional affected users after which the issue stops being ignored.

ignoreUserWindow.description: Time window in minutes for ignoreUserCount.

inCommit.description: Commit the issue is resolved in.

subscriptionDetails.description: Why the requesting user is subscribed to the issue. Null when there's no subscription.

disabled.description: Whether the requesting user turned off notifications for the issue.

reason.description: Why the requesting user is subscribed, such as `commented`, `assigned`, `bookmarked`, `changed_status`, `mentioned` or `unknown`.

type.description: The event type of the issue, such as `error` or `default`.

userCount.description: The number of users affected by the issue.

put.description:
Bulk mutate various attributes on issues.  The list of issues to modify is given through the `id` query parameter.  It is repeated for each issue that should be modified.

- For non-status updates, the `id` query parameter is required.
- For status updates, the `id` query parameter may be omitted
for a batch "update all" query.
- To restrict a batch "update all" to issues with a given status,
use the `query` parameter, e.g. `query=is:resolved`.

The following attributes can be modified and are supplied as JSON object in the body:

If any IDs are out of scope this operation will succeed without any data mutation.
put.operationId: Bulk Mutate a List of Issues

parameters.name: organization_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the organization the issues belong to.

parameters.name: project_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the project the issues belong to.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A list of IDs of the issues to be mutated. This parameter shall be repeated for each issue. It is optional only if a status is mutated in which case an implicit update all is assumed.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: An optional Sentry structured search query that selects the issues to update when `id` is not provided. If not provided an implied `"is:unresolved"` is assumed. Use `is:<status>` (e.g. `is:resolved`) to limit it to issues with that status.

status.description: The new status for the issues. Valid values are `"resolved"`, `"resolvedInNextRelease"`, `"unresolved"`, and `"ignored"`.

statusDetails.description: Additional details about the resolution. Valid values are `"inRelease"`, `"inNextRelease"`, `"inCommit"`, `"ignoreDuration"`, `"ignoreCount"`, `"ignoreWindow"`, `"ignoreUserCount"`, and `"ignoreUserWindow"`.

ignoreDuration.description: The number of minutes to ignore this issue.

isPublic.description: Sets the issue to public or private.

merge.description: Allows to merge or unmerge different issues.

assignedTo.description: The actor ID (or username) of the user or team that should be assigned to this issue.

hasSeen.description: In case this API call is invoked with a user context this allows changing of the flag that indicates if the user has seen the event.

isBookmarked.description: In case this API call is invoked with a user context this allows changing of the bookmark flag.

isPublic.description: Whether the issues are shared publicly.

status.description: The new status of the issues.

statusDetails.description: Details of the new status, such as the release that resolves the issues or when an ignore expires. Empty when the new status has no details.

ignoreCount.description: Number of additional events after which the issues stop being ignored.

ignoreUntil.description: When the issues stop being ignored.

ignoreUserCount.description: Number of additional affected users after which the issues stop being ignored.

ignoreUserWindow.description: Time window in minutes for ignoreUserCount.

ignoreWindow.description: Time window in minutes for ignoreCount.

ignoreUntilEscalating.description: Whether the issues stay ignored until they escalate.

actor.description: User who ignored or resolved the issues.

inNextRelease.description: Whether the issues are resolved in the next release.

inRelease.description: Version of the release the issues are resolved in.

inCommit.description: Commit the issues are resolved in.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

delete.description:
Permanently remove the given issues. The list of issues to modify is given through the `id` query parameter.  It is repeated for each issue that should be removed.

If any IDs are out of scope this operation will succeed without any data mutation.
delete.operationId: Bulk Remove a List of Issues

parameters.name: organization_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the organization the issues belong to.

parameters.name: project_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the project the issues belong to.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A list of IDs of the issues to be removed. This parameter shall be repeated for each issue, e.g. `?id=1&id=2&id=3`. If this parameter is not provided, it will attempt to remove the first 1000 issues.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: An optional Sentry structured search query that selects the issues to remove when `id` is not provided. If not provided an implied `"is:unresolved"` is assumed. Use `is:<status>` (e.g. `is:resolved`) to limit it to issues with that status.
